events.name: Bash
events.input: git status --short && git log --oneline -10 && find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -50

events.name: Bash
events.input: for f in README.md scripts/retry.sh CHANGELOG.md; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls -la docs 2><path>; git show --stat HEAD | head -20
